finding.text: The diff doesn't touch any of the asks in `requirements.md`. It is the "name the mastermind for its job" docs pass (worktree/mastermind-word, commit 4815cea5e), not the task-completion work. There is no node script listing v-sq8y7db's tasks, no output file, no done/total checked against the `completion` query, no cause with file:line, no `plan.md`, no screen timing, and no `log` lines in `session.jsonl`. This is the second wrong pairing: the earlier review (`../session.jsonl:193`) was handed an unrelated ChatV2Model.js diff. Either run the brief, or check that whoever starts `review.mjs` for this task passes this task's own branch.

`task-completion/` holds only `requirements.md` and `review/`: no `task.jsonl`, no owner agent, no progress. A fresh agent can't continue from this folder. It can't tell whether the work started, who holds it (`d9bb08bc9` says "mastermind-tasks-completion"), or whether the gate in requirements.md ("do not start until the owner okays proposal.md") is still closed. `proposal.md` line 3 says "hold lifted for safe fixes". Record the owner agent and the gate's current state in the folder.

`Servex/agents/session-smart.md:204,232` (diff lines 204 and 232) now tell the smart seat to `spawn_agent({role: "mastermind", …})`. But `Servex/agents/policy.js:148` refuses exactly that role for a `session-smart-*` caller ("may spawn task masterminds…"), and `policy.js:169` still says "except assistants and mastermind". The policy is off by default (`policy.js:24`), so nothing breaks today, but with `SERVEX_POLICY=on` every spawn the new wording asks for is refused. Change the deny list at :148 and the text at :169 along with the docs.

`Servex/agents/readme.md` (diff line 93) now says the Dispatcher "spawns a `mastermind` agent". The code at `Servex/agents/Dispatcher.js:134` spawns `role: "page-mastermind"` (manager, medium), so the new sentence is still wrong, only in a different way. `Dispatcher.js:8` still says `task-mastermind`. Name `page-mastermind` in the readme and fix the comment.

The rename isn't finished. `task-mastermind` still appears as guidance in `Servex/agents/tools.js:251` (the quick_fix description the fixer reads), `roles.js:41,89-90`, and around 20 docs under `Servex/agents/doc/` and `Servex/doc/` (grep `task-mastermind`). Fixer.md now says to spawn `mastermind`, but the `quick_fix` tool text it is given still says task-mastermind.

`public/framework/ai/doc/agent-rules.md` (diff line 246) links `/Servex/agents/doc/names.md`. `Servex/` is not under `public/`, so on the site that link most likely 404s. `roles.md` already uses the same pattern, so check which link style is meant for repo-only files.

In the diff's own scope the edits are consistent with `roles.js:54`: one `mastermind` row whose aliases include `task-mastermind` and `sub-mastermind`, and a `path` field on spawn_agent (`tools.js:347`). The new agent-rules.md section is short and clear.

The diff (branch `worktree/mastermind-word`, commits 4815cea5e and 837bff550) still does none of the four steps in `requirements.md`: no node script listing v-sq8y7db's tasks, no output file, no done/total checked against the `completion` query, no cause given with file:line, no `plan.md`, no screen timing. The author's reply in `task.jsonl` says the pairing is on purpose, but this folder is the task-completion task, so a pass here would mark it done when its asks are unmet.

A fresh agent can't continue from this folder. `task.jsonl` holds only review lines, and the gate in `requirements.md:5` ("Do not start until the owner okays") is still unticked. Nothing here says the work moved to mastermind-tasks-completion (commits d9bb08bc9, 4ec0c70b3) or where its records live. Add one line to `task.jsonl` or `requirements.md` naming the owner agent and linking its records.

The docs now contradict each other about which role owns one task. `public/framework/ai/doc/agent-rules.md` (new section) says there is ONE `mastermind` role and that whoever hands off work spawns `role: "mastermind"`. But `Servex/agents/readme.md:61` and `Dispatcher.js:8,134` call `page-mastermind` "the one-task row" (manager tier, Sonnet, medium effort). `mastermind` is the architect row (`roles.js:54`: Opus, high effort). So the smart seat's hand-offs (`session-smart.md`, diff lines 84 and 93) now start Opus-high agents, while the Dispatcher starts Sonnet agents for the same kind of job, which goes against CLAUDE.md's "Sonnet by default". Pick one row for one-task work and say it in both places, or have the session-smart spawn line pass `model`/`effort`.

The policy fix holds: `policy.js:148` now lets a `session-smart-*` caller spawn `mastermind`, and the `rules()` row at `policy.js:169` matches. Policy is off by default (`SERVEX_POLICY`), so it was never a live block.
`names.md`'s new sentence "the id prefix is whatever word the caller passed" is right: `Agents.js:579` `name()` joins the raw `role` word, not the row's `prefix`.

Old wording remains at `Servex/agents/tools.js:49` (the DORMANT_AFTER comment says "task-mastermind"), and about 40 lines under `Servex/agents/readme.md`, `Servex/agents/doc/` and `Servex/doc/` still say "task mastermind". The author's reply leaves these to the architect. `readme.md:104` still links `doc/task-mastermind-long-form.md` by its old name.
`agent-rules.md`'s link `/Servex/agents/doc/names.md` points outside `public/`, so it won't resolve on the site. This was raised before and is still open.
